record.title: Recover the calibration initialization subsystem and its environment contract
record.intent: Replace access-by-access discovery with a typed static graph of calibration loaders algorithms and thread startup.
requirements: Pin unchanged stock ELF and existing initialization-tail evidence; begin at the unexecuted GetScope to GetCalibration to CCalibration initialization path.

Recover the complete calibration initialization dispatcher and reachable loader sequencing selectors defaults error propagation and thread startup; expand directly relevant helpers through their first environment or hardware boundary.

Enumerate file paths formats sizes properties Android dependencies mapped reads and writes ioctl DMA and asynchronous interfaces where reached; correlate driver plumbing only with pinned reference or stock-module evidence and label provenance.

Emit a reproducible typed TOML graph with addresses instruction witnesses call edges tables loops branch conditions and operation classes STATIC-DETERMINED RUNTIME-SELECTED HARDWARE-RETURNED ASYNCHRONOUS or UNKNOWN.
Keep unresolved indirect calls and deeper algorithms explicit; do not claim complete transitive recovery without coverage evidence and do not infer FPGA behavior from software plumbing.
Do not execute a guest or introduce new modeled responses in this static task; preserve official artifacts byte-for-byte.
acceptance: Commit and push the recovered contract and unresolved boundaries.
